text.pageLead: A Night’s Watch runner. Leap the horrors beyond the Wall — and when a dragon comes, hold your ground and man the crossbow.
text.readyLine2: When the dragon appears, {aim} to aim the crossbow — it fires on its own.
text.gameOverTitle: And now his watch is ended.
text.reviveLine: The Lord of Light is not done with you…
text.dragonBanner: {name} attacks! Steer the crossbow — it fires on its own
text.controlsTouch: Jump: tap · Aim the crossbow: drag on the screen
text.controlsDesktop: Jump: Space / ↑ / click · Aim the crossbow: move your mouse
